Medical Imaging Suite 1.0.0

- Initial release of a complete medical imaging solution.
- Features OHIF viewer deployment and DICOMweb integration (tbidea, orthanc, DCM4CHEE).
- Integrates TotalSegmentator and supports MONAI workflows.
- Includes simple Docker-based deployment options.
- Minimum requirement: Docker and 4GB RAM.
